basic.about: three full frames, per-frame delays 100/200/300 ms

zero_delay.about: delays of 0 and 1 cs - the desktop clamps both up to 20 ms

short_delays.about: 2, 3 and 7 cs - where Qt's own small-delay floor stops

no_gce.about: a frame with no Graphic Control Extension at all

no_gce_after_transparent.about: a GCE-less frame after a transparent one: does the transparent index carry over

restore_background_opaque.about: disposal 2 with NO transparent index: what the vacated rect becomes

restore_background_transparent.about: disposal 2 on a frame that HAS a transparent index

restore_background_alpha.about: disposal 2 on a canvas that carries alpha (its first frame is transparent)

restore_previous.about: disposal 3 puts back what was under the frame

transparent_overlay.about: transparent pixels in a disposal-1 frame leave the frame below showing

first_frame_subrect.about: a first frame smaller than the screen: what fills the rest

first_frame_subrect_transparent.about: the same, when the first frame carries a transparent index

local_palette.about: a frame carrying its own colour table

interlaced.about: interlaced frames, an odd height to exercise every pass

big_lzw.about: 256 colours of noise: the code width grows to 12 bits and clears

single_frame.about: one frame - the ordinary, non-animated image path
